title: Black September: Syrian armour in Jordan (1970)

fronts.name: Syrian armour in northern Jordan (the border with Syria)
fronts.commit_label: Send troops to the border with Syria as a warning

cite.quote: on September 19, Syria sent tanks to Jordan to support the Palestinians.
Israel did not attack but demonstrated its willingness to intervene by sending troops to the border with Syria and fighter planes over Syrian tanks in Jordan

fronts.name: the skies over the Syrian tanks in Jordan
fronts.commit_label: Fly fighter patrols over the Syrian tanks in Jordan

cite.quote: Israel did not attack but demonstrated its willingness to intervene by sending troops to the border with Syria and fighter planes over Syrian tanks in Jordan

variants.note: Your cabinet chose to act against the Syrian armour: committing to a front now strikes the Syrian formations. The Syrian withdrawal follows within days either way.
